comment: DVB-S2 BBHEADER, normal mode: MATYPE (TS/GS, SIS/MIS, CCM/ACM, ISSYI, NPD, roll-off; second byte), UPL, DFL, SYNC, SYNCD and a CRC-8 over the first 9 bytes, then DFL data bits, padded to fill the BBFRAME (Kbch bits, set per frame by the PLS). Transmitting it is a single generic continuous stream with ACM/VCM, filling every frame
